result.email_draft:
Subject: Price Discrepancy on Invoice NW-8008 – PO-2026-1008

Dear Accounts Receivable Team,

Our reference is PO-2026-1008. Invoice NW-8008, dated October 5, 2026, for a total of USD 1,072.50, is currently on hold due to a pricing discrepancy.

For item MON-27, the invoice reflects a unit price of USD 214.50, whereas the agreed purchase order price is USD 210.00 per unit. For 5 units, this results in a difference of USD 22.50.

Please confirm that the correct unit price for MON-27 under PO-2026-1008 is USD 210.00. We kindly request that you issue a credit note for the difference or provide a corrected invoice.

Kind regards,
